## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the final change and why it is needed. Link the owning Issue with Refs #N. Keep it open until integrated-revision checks, acceptance documentation and resource closure pass; do not use closing keywords.

## Compliance and scope

Cite the relevant CHALLENGE.md requirement; distinguish required behavior from a permitted choice. Record blocked contradictions and the compatible alternative. Identify affected workflows and material limits.

## Validation

List actual checks, candidate revision/scenario/environment and useful CI/report links. Distinguish historical evidence from this candidate. Identify any manual/semantic review and limitations.

## Ready for integration

- [ ] Final diff, scope, Issue acceptance and company compliance reviewed.
- [ ] Required candidate checks/CI pass for the current head.
- [ ] Acceptance documentation and truthful checkpoint are in the candidate.

## Remaining completion gate

Name the integrated-main checks, other post-merge acceptance and resource cleanup still required. These keep the Issue open/In progress. The completion comment records outcome, criteria, PR/commit, evidence and limitations before explicit closure/Project Done.

The template prompts review. Repository CI does not automatically validate these boxes or semantic acceptance.
